# A render slot inside a container that is not a box, on fyne and gtk4.
#
# scroll.sngl: a reactive `if` directly inside a scroll, which holds one child.
# The slot renders into a box that child is; before, fyne did not build and gtk4
# handed the GtkScrolledWindow to gtk_box_append with a CRITICAL per call.
#
# stack.sngl: a reactive `for` directly inside gtk4's stack, a GtkStack holding
# several children through a call of its own. It is refused by name, where it
# used to fail to compile with the C types as the only explanation.

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'

sngl test --platform=fyne scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok'
! stderr 'CRITICAL'

! sngl test --platform=gtk4 stack.sngl
stderr 'a reactive `if` or `for` directly inside a GtkStack cannot be rendered'

-- scroll.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var on = true

    vbox {
        scroll {
            if on {
                text(value="on")
            }
        }
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { on = !on })
    }
}

func testFlip(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(c.on)
}

window {
    main
}
-- stack.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var items = ["a"]

    vbox {
        stack {
            for var it = items {
                text(value=it)
            }
        }
        button #more(text="more", @click { items.push("b") })
    }
}

func testMore(t Test, c main) {
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.items.length == 2)
}

window {
    main
}
